building.name: TOWER-RED
building.facade_note: The north-east edge of the unit follows the plot boundary and building line (קו בניין, see note 12). A decorative beam (קורה דקורטיבית) runs along that edge. The sun terrace is on the east side with a curved glazed edge. Structural columns stand in the terrace zone. A dashed 'קו קומה מעל' marks the floor above. A narrow passage (מעבר צר) sits at the south end of the terrace, with a printed height of about 1.80 m (H=כ-1.80 מ').

drawing.north_note: The north arrow is beside the floor key in the title block. Its pointer lies about 22° above the left horizontal, which gives roughly 292° clockwise from the top of the sheet. The unit plan is drawn rotated on the sheet. The site key has its own small north arrow at the bottom right, which was not measured. The building permit reference on the sheet is 25-1222.

openings_summary: The unit entrance (כניסה) is on the west side. There is a swing door to the general bathroom, a swing door to the master bathroom, and a door to the master bedroom area. The living room has an exit to the terrace (יציאה למרפסת). The east facade and the curved glazing along the kitchen, dining area and living room face the sun terrace. The bedroom's glazing is on the north-east edge under the decorative beam.
